references.text: But what comes out of the mouth comes from the heart, and that is what makes a person unclean.
The good person brings forth good things from their good storehouse, and the evil person brings forth evil things from their evil storehouse. For the mouth speaks what the heart is full of.
Also the tongue is a fire. Like a world of injustice, so is the tongue among our members. It stains the whole body, sets the course of life on fire, and is itself set on fire by hell.
